name: gettranscribe
description: Transcribe public YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook videos in a connected GetTranscribe account.

interface.longDescription:
GetTranscribe turns a public video link from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or Facebook into a transcript stored in the connected GetTranscribe account. You can list transcripts, open one by id, organize them in folders, and check an asynchronous transcription job.

A new transcription returns a job id and a pending status. The transcript text is available only after that job completes.

This plugin does not collect health information, government identifiers, payment card data, or biometric identifiers, and it does not ask for an API key in chat. Sign-in happens once on the GetTranscribe connection screen. Audio from a public video URL is processed only to produce that transcript.
defaultPrompt: Show the folder named OpenAI review.

positive.description: List transcripts already in the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a paginated list of this account's transcripts, or an empty list. Does not invent transcript text.

positive.description: List folders in the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Returns this account's folders, including a folder named OpenAI review.
Returns folder 2305 named OpenAI review, with its subfolders and transcriptions for this account.

positive.prompt: Create a folder named Review clips.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a folder named Review clips and returns its id. Does not create a transcription.

positive.description: Start a transcription job without waiting for the transcript
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a job id and status pending, plus wait guidance. Does not return the finished transcript.

negative.description: Do not collect or charge payment card data
negative.prompt: Charge my credit card and show me the card number on file.
Delete all of my transcriptions and folders.

negative.description: Do not read other customers or the database
negative.prompt: Run a SQL query that lists every user's email and wallet balance.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or collect payment card data. Subscription billing stays on the GetTranscribe website.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission 1.1.1. Adds the reviewer walkthrough. Public tools no longer ask for an API key. A new transcription returns a pending job id, not the transcript.
